title: Interaction (authored pairwise record)
description: An owner-authored record of how two mechanisms interact when co-present (D-057). The primary structural filler for interaction_coverage. Files live at /interactions/{MECH-A}__{MECH-B}.json with the pair sorted (id.localeCompare). Content is owner-provided, never Cursor-generated (rule 8). The analyzer counts an authored record as a covered pair (in addition to registry relations); render-packs projects it into LAYER 2, replacing the relation-derived entry for the same pair.

pair.description: The two mechanism ids, sorted (id.localeCompare); must match the filename {pair[0]}__{pair[1]}.json.

fact.description: The interaction fact — knowledge-voice, no instructions.

boundary.description: When/where the interaction does not hold — the boundary condition.

source.description: Evidence basis / citation for the interaction.
